metadata.name: A deterministic node inside the trail
metadata.description: Two work nodes on one edge: the first declares engine "shell" and runs the command its pinned skill carries — no session, no model — and the second says nothing about an engine and falls into the runner's default. The smallest document that puts a script inside the graph instead of beside it (t332).

nodes.description: Runs the arithmetic as a command. Its pinned skill declares a `command` block, so the runner spawns that argv instead of opening a session.

checks.description: The command printed a measurement, and not an empty one.

nodes.description: Writes down what the measurement said. Declares no engine: the one that runs is the runner's default engine, with a model behind it.

checks.instruction: Does the write-up state the measurement it was given, without adding one nobody produced? Quote the line that carries it.
checks.description: A judgement about faithfulness to the deterministic step, with evidence of its own.

edges.description: A single exit: what was measured always goes on to be written down.
